name: James A. McClure
desc: American attorney, Idaho State Senator and U.S. Senator for the State of Idaho (1924-2011)
summary: James Albertus McClure (December 27, 1924 – February 26, 2011) was an American lawyer and politician from the state of Idaho, most notably serving as a Republican in the U.S. Senate for three terms from 1973 to 1991. He also served three terms in the U.S. House of Representatives from 1967 to 1973.
